newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates plunge on surplus funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates plunge on surplus funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates plunged on Tuesday amid surplus funds and dealers said Wednesday's rates would depend on the results of an auction of short-term federal bond conducted by the central bank.
"Right from the begining, the overnight market traded at 1.0 percent owing to surplus funds in the system," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.

He said the State Bank of Pakistan received bids worth about 25.77 billion rupees in its auction of short-term bonds on Tuesday. Wednesday's rates would depend on the auction results due to be announced later on Tuesday. - Amir Zia 9221-5685192
